reviews.text: We've been using P&A Painting & Carpentry since 2014 for exterior house painting. For the job just finished, Andreas Jr. and his crew once again did an outstanding job including power washing our concrete and repairs to some weathered wood trim. They are trustworthy, punctual, and very pleasant to deal with. I will continue using P&A for my painting needs.

P&A helped us scrape away a century of old paint on the front columns of our old colonial. They then meticulously prepped the area and finished with a fresh coat of paint. It brought new life to our front porch. Highly recommend Andreas. Professional, courteous, and reasonable pricing.

P&A painting, Andreas and his crew did excellent, meticulous work in our home.  It was a big job that required extensive prep work and throughout Andreas was flexible and the finished work looks great!

I cannot recommend this painter highly enough! He just finished painting the interior of my home, and the results are absolutely flawless. From start to finish, his work was excellent, professional, and incredibly neat. He paid attention to every single detail, showed up on time, and left my home spotless. If you are looking for a skilled, reliable painter who does top-tier work, look no further. I will definitely be hiring him again for future projects!
